verdict.reason:
Verified by reading all four sites and by an executed reproduction test (inserted temporarily into secret.rs's test module, run with `cargo test --lib`, then reverted — tree confirmed clean).

Code facts:
- `C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/temp/demo/SynaRoute/src-tauri/src/secret.rs:314-349` — `enable_master_password` enforces four gates in order: non-empty (:320), `len < 8` (:323), must contain both a letter and a digit (:330-337), and a `WEAK_PASSWORDS` substring blacklist (:340-349, list starts with "12345678", "password", "admin123"…).
- `C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/temp/demo/SynaRoute/src-tauri/src/secret.rs:478-485` — `change_master_password`'s only gates are `!is_master_mode()` (:479) and `new.is_empty()` (:482). No length, no complexity, no blacklist. It then does the full-vault rewrite with `derive_vault_key(new, …)` at :508.
- No validation exists at any other layer on the change path: the Tauri command at `C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/temp/demo/SynaRoute/src-tauri/src/lib.rs:167-179` calls `SecretStore::change_master_password` directly (it does not go through `service.rs`, unlike enable/disable at `service.rs:505/513`), and `crypto::derive_vault_key` (`crypto.rs:146-149`) only rejects empty.
- Frontend: `C:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/temp/demo/SynaRoute/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx:1656-1663` — one shared `pwProblem` for both `enable` and `change`, checking only `pw.length < 8` and `pw !== pw2`; it gates the submit button via `canSubmit` (:1665-1668). The only stated rule the user ever sees is `i18n.ts:628` "主口令至少 8 位".
- No comment, doc, or design note anywhere states the policy intentionally applies only to enable: `grep -rni "弱口令|口令强度|WEAK_PASSWORD|strength" src/ docs/ src-tauri/src/` returns exactly one hit — the comment at `secret.rs:319` inside `enable_master_password`. So this is not a documented deliberate exception.

Executed repro (temp test, passed): after `enable_master_password("OldPass123")`, fresh stores reject `enable_master_password` for all of "password", "abcdefgh", "12345678", while on the same live store `change_master_password("OldPass123","password")` → Ok(1), then chained to "abcdefgh" → Ok(1) and "12345678" → Ok(1). Re-loading `secrets.enc` from disk and calling `unlock("12345678")` succeeds and the key decrypts. So the whole vault ends up sealed under a password the program explicitly claims to reject, and the state is durable, not transient.

This is the project's forbidden form ①/④ in miniature: the strength policy is a real gate on one entrance and a no-op on the other, and nothing reports the discrepancy. Not a style/refactor complaint — the failure is deterministic and observable from the UI.
verdict.correction:
Finding stands as written; three refinements worth folding into the fix.

1. The frontend gap is broader than the report implies, and it matters for the fix's UX half. `SettingsPage.tsx:1656-1663` never checks complexity for **either** kind — on `enable`, the letter+digit and blacklist rules are enforced only by the backend, and the user discovers them via the (well-worded, multi-line) `AppError::Invalid` text rendered at `SettingsPage.tsx:1781-1785`. So today enable = "silent frontend, loud backend"; change = "silent both". Extracting `fn validate_master_password(pw: &str) -> AppResult<()>` from `secret.rs:319-349` and calling it from both entrances is sufficient to close the security hole by itself; updating `i18n.ts:628` to "8 位以上且含字母与数字" is the separate readability improvement.

2. The report's exclusion list is correct and load-bearing, not incidental: `disable_master_password` (:422) and `unlock` (:132) verify an **existing** password, so validating them would hard-lock exactly the users this bug created — someone who set "password" via change would be unable to turn the mode off, which is the project's forbidden form ② (dead end with no self-service escape). Do not "unify" all four.

3. One property of the extracted validator to be aware of: `WEAK_PASSWORDS` matching is `password_lower.contains(weak)` (:345), i.e. substring, not equality — so a shared validator will also reject otherwise-strong choices like "MyPassword123". That is pre-existing enable behavior and shipping it on change is the consistent outcome, but it means the change dialog will start rejecting inputs it previously accepted; the error text at :346-348 is generic ("检测到常见弱口令模式"), so consider naming the matched pattern to keep it actionable. No existing user gets locked out by this, since change only validates the *new* password.

Severity P2 is right: no data loss, no key loss (the rewrite path at :505-529 still backs up and rolls back correctly), only weaker-than-promised protection plus a policy that answers differently on two entrances.

confirmed.title: 启动自检事件 kind "system" 未在前端登记，每次启动都在日志里显示成绿色「路由」
confirmed.scenario: 任何一次正常启动。lib.rs:1257 写入「启动自检 · 配置=... · keys=N · 用户=... · exe=...」，kind="system"。打开「运行日志」，这条（MSIX 平行宇宙排障的核心证据行，CLAUDE.md 明确要求靠它核对）显示为绿色 success 徽标 + 文案「路由」/"Route"。排障时用户/支持人员按「系统」分组去找能找到，但徽标语义与内容完全不符；若照徽标理解会当成一次成功转发。

Every link in the evidence chain reproduces exactly as claimed; line numbers are precise.

1. Emission: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1259` passes `"system"` as `kind` to `store.append_event(CategoryType::ClaudeCli, "system", None, &format!("启动自检 · 配置=... · keys=... · 用户=... · exe=..."))`. This is the ONLY `"system"` event kind in the whole Rust tree (`grep -rn '"system"' src-tauri/src/` — all other hits are `theme: "system"` in model.rs or the `system` message role in upstream/convert.rs).

2. Transport, unmodified: `src-tauri/src/model.rs:1516-1517` — `#[serde(rename = "type")] pub kind: String`. It is a free-form `String`, not an enum, so `"system"` is serialized verbatim as `"type":"system"`. `store.rs:844-846 list_all_events` does `.iter().map(Self::strip_trace).collect()` — no filtering, no normalization. `src/store.ts:391-394` just `reuseUnchanged(s.events, events)` — no normalization frontend-side either.

3. Type union out of sync: `src/types.ts:396` — `type: "route" | "failover" | "health" | "aggregate" | "error" | "warning" | "request" | "mcp" | "config";` — no `"system"`. No compile error is produced because the Rust side is an untyped `String`; TS never sees the mismatch.

4. Wrong badge: `src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:306` — `const meta = TYPE_META[entry.type] ?? TYPE_META.route;`. `TYPE_META` (declared :28, entries :32-40) has no `system` key → falls back to `TYPE_META.route` = `{ tKey: "logs.type.route", variant: "success", icon: Radio }` (:32). Rendered at `LogsPage.tsx:346-348`: `<Badge variant={meta.variant}><Icon size={10}/>{t(meta.tKey)}</Badge>` → green success badge, radio icon, label `t("logs.type.route")` = "路由" (`src/lib/i18n.ts:548`) / "Route" (`:1322`). There is no `logs.type.system` key in i18n at all (grep over src/lib/i18n.ts returns only route/failover/health/aggregate/error/warning/request/mcp/config).

5. Grouping is correct only by accident, as the finding states: `GROUP_OF` (declared :49, entries :50-62) also has no `system` entry, but the call site `LogsPage.tsx:127` is `const g = GROUP_OF[e.type] ?? "system";` — the fallback literal happens to equal the desired group, so the "系统" filter tab finds the row and masks the badge bug.

Reproducible scenario: launch the app at all, open 运行日志. The very first (oldest) row is the startup self-check, wearing a green success badge reading "路由"/"Route" with a radio icon. Not a style preference — the badge asserts a factually wrong event type (pattern ④ 静默用错值而不报错), and this exact class is already treated as a confirmed defect by the codebase itself: the comment at `LogsPage.tsx:60-62` says `warning` was deliberately mapped into the error group because otherwise "会被渲染成绿色成功图标而彻底埋没（本轮审查确认的缺陷）". Aggravating factor: CLAUDE.md designates this specific line as the core evidence row for MSIX parallel-universe triage, so it is mislabeled as a successful forward precisely during the diagnostic it exists to serve.

verdict.correction:
Finding stands as written. Three refinements worth carrying into the fix:

(a) Root cause is narrower than "three places are missing an entry". `TYPE_META` and `GROUP_OF` are both declared as `Record<EventLogEntry["type"], ...>` (LogsPage.tsx:28-31 and :49), so the union in types.ts:396 ALREADY enforces exhaustiveness over both maps. The single actual gap is that the TS union is out of sync with the Rust `String` field. Adding `"system"` to types.ts:396 first will make `npm run build` / tsc fail on both maps until entries are added — the compiler does the rest of the work for you. Fix order matters: types.ts first, then the two maps go red and tell you where to go.

(b) `GROUP_OF["system"]` being absent is currently harmless (the `?? "system"` fallback at :127 lands on the right group), but adding the explicit `system: "system"` entry is still required once the union is widened, or tsc breaks.

(c) The proposed structural guard should target the union/`String` seam, not the maps. The Rust `kind` being `String` (model.rs:1517, with a stale doc comment listing only `route | failover | health | aggregate | error | request` — already missing `warning`/`mcp`/`config`/`system`) is what allows any new backend kind to silently reach the UI. Making it an enum with `#[serde(rename_all="kebab-case")]`, or asserting the emitted-kind set in a Rust test, closes the class; adding entries to a TS map does not.

confirmed.title: 上游 max_tokens 截断已检测出来，但只写进 trace（默认关），默认配置下截断完全不可见
confirmed.scenario: 保持默认设置（settings.request_log_enabled = false）。客户端发一个 max_tokens 偏小的非流式请求，上游返回 `stop_reason: "max_tokens"`（或 OpenAI `finish_reason: "length"`）。proxy.rs:1029 已经算出 was_truncated=Some(true) 并传进 log_success，但 log_success 只把它塞进 `req_log.then(|| RequestTrace{...})` 里 —— 开关关着时 trace 为 None、has_trace=false，该行在日志页**不可展开**，detail 只有「Key名 · 成功返回 · 模型 X · 1234ms · ↑1.2k ↓4.0k」。i18n 里那条 `logs.trace.truncatedWarning` 文案在默认配置下永远不会出现。用户看到答案被切一半，日志里显示「成功返回」，无法判断是截断还是模型自己停了，也没有任何提示去调大 max_tokens。
confirmed.evidence: src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:1029-1031 计算 was_truncated；src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:650 `let trace = req_log.then(|| RequestTrace { ... was_truncated });` —— was_truncated 的唯一去向被 req_log 门控；src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:640-647 log_success 拼 detail 时完全不含截断信息；src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:406 `{trace.wasTruncated && ...}` 是该字段全仓唯一消费点，而它在 TraceDetail 内、只有 hasTrace 为真才渲染。（对照：usage 就是刻意提到 EventLogEntry 顶层字段的，理由与此完全同构。）
confirmed.fix: 两种都行、二者取一：(a) 在 log_success 的 detail 里无条件追加截断标记（如 `was_truncated == Some(true)` 时补 " · ⚠️ 被输出上限截断"），成本为零且折叠行也能看到；(b) 把 was_truncated 提到 EventLogEntry 顶层（与 usage 同处理，1 字节），LogsPage 在行首挂一个 warning 徽标，不依赖 trace 开关。

Every load-bearing claim checks out; I could not falsify it.

1. Detection exists and is non-streaming only: `src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:1028-1031` — `let was_truncated = parsed_body.as_ref().and_then(|v| crate::upstream::is_truncated_response(v).then_some(true));`
2. Sole sink is the req_log-gated trace: `src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:650` `let trace = req_log.then(|| RequestTrace {` … `:662 was_truncated,`. `req_log` comes from `proxy.rs:599 let req_log = store.request_log_enabled()` → `store.rs:2154-2155` → `AppSettings::request_log_enabled`, whose default is **false** (`model.rs:1930`; `src/types.ts:448` comment 「调用模型日志（默认关…）」). Grep for `was_truncated`/`wasTruncated` over the whole repo returns only: the model field (`model.rs:1589`), five `None` initializers (aggregate/mcp/store/proxy:725), the computation site, the trace construction, and one frontend consumer. There is no other sink.
3. Collapsed detail carries nothing: `proxy.rs:641-648` builds `"{key.name} · {verb} · {model} · {elapsed}ms{usage_part}"` — no truncation term. So the row literally reads 「成功返回」.
4. Not even the log file keeps it: `store.rs:566 has_trace: trace.is_some()` → false, and `store.rs:570 self.write_log_to_file(&entry)` writes that same `trace: None` entry — so the flag is discarded from memory *and* from disk, despite `store.rs:569` calling the file 「逐条完整的事实来源」.
5. Frontend consumer is trace-gated exactly as claimed: `src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:388 {open && entry.hasTrace && (` → `TraceDetail` at `:401` → `:406 {trace.wasTruncated && (`. With `hasTrace=false` the banner and `logs.trace.truncatedWarning` (`src/lib/i18n.ts:573` / `:1347`) are unreachable in the default config.
6. The cited precedent is real and sits 6 lines above the bug: `proxy.rs:635-637` — 「token 用量直接写进 detail：这是用户判断「额度花在哪」的唯一入口，藏在链路快照里等于没有（快照默认关、且要展开才看得到）」. That is verbatim the same argument, and `usage` was consequently lifted to the `EventLogEntry` top level (`store.rs:565`). Nothing anywhere documents a decision to accept the trace-only placement for truncation, so this reads as oversight, not deliberate design.
7. The intent it fails to meet is on record: commit `e0472b3` is titled 「fix(A5-11/A5-12): 截断可见性——上游 max_tokens 截断不再静默当成成功」 and `docs/14:1732 §17.3` frames the goal as 「截断对用户仍然不可见」→ visible. Only the client-facing half (A5-12) landed unconditionally; the log-facing half (A5-11) is gated behind a default-off switch.
verdict.correction:
Three refinements to the finding, none of which overturn it:

(a) **Not a total blackout — scope it to SynaRoute's own log.** A5-12 works unconditionally: `upstream/convert.rs:1150` and `:1496` preserve the truncation signal across protocol conversion, and `proxy.rs:1046` returns the upstream bytes verbatim (`json_resp(StatusCode::OK, bytes)`). A client that inspects `stop_reason`/`finish_reason`/`status` still sees it. The defect is that SynaRoute's *own* log page and log file — the place the fix commit and docs/14 §17.3 explicitly aimed at — show 「成功返回」 with zero hint. P2/usability is the right severity; this is not P1 (no wrong data, no dead-end error).

(b) **Coverage is even narrower than the finding states.** Truncation is never detected on streaming at all: the two `log_success` call sites are `proxy.rs:908` (streaming, passes `None` with comment 「流式直通时无法检测截断（边收边发，不解析完整响应）」 at `:918`) and `proxy.rs:1036` (non-streaming). Claude Code CLI and Codex normally stream, so even with the log switch ON the warning banner only ever fires for non-streaming traffic (brain aggregate, non-stream `/v1/messages`, etc.). The practical blast radius of this finding is therefore smaller than "every truncated request".

(c) **Fix (b) is strictly better than fix (a), and it also closes (b) above.** The 「无法检测」 comment is softer than it sounds: the same-protocol streaming path already keeps an 8 KB tail window (`proxy.rs:1349 TAIL_WINDOW_BYTES`, filled at `:1621`, snapshotted and parsed unconditionally at `:1639-1668`) and already patches the *already-written* row in place via `store.backfill_usage_for_collapsed_event` (`proxy.rs:1670-1680`) — that backfill is not gated by `req_log`. Anthropic's terminal `message_delta` carrying `delta.stop_reason == "max_tokens"` lives in exactly that tail window. So lifting `was_truncated` to the `EventLogEntry` top level (next to `usage`, `store.rs:565`) plus a `backfill_truncated_for_collapsed_event` sibling gets both the non-streaming and same-protocol-streaming cases visible with no new buffering. Appending a marker to `detail` (option a) fixes only the non-streaming case and cannot be backfilled after the stream ends, since `detail` is written before the body is seen.

verdict.reason:
核心机制逐条实测成立，且场景可复现、非刻意设计。

1) 排序确认：`src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:575-582` 无条件写事件（kind="failover"、key_id=None、走 `store.append_event`），`src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:587` 的 529 短路检查在其**之后**。中间没有任何 return，故窗口内每个被短路的请求都会先写这一条。

2) 不可折叠确认：`src-tauri/src/store.rs:495-515` `append_event` → `append_event_trace(trace=None)` → `append_event_collapsible(collapse_key=None)`；`store.rs:592-596` `push_event_in_memory` 仅在 `collapse_key` 为 `Some` 且与最后一条相同时才 `repeat+=1`。collapse_key 为 None ⇒ 永不折叠（`store.rs:3854-3856` 有测试锁住该语义）。

3) 每条的实际代价确认：`store.rs:571` `write_log_to_file` 无条件投递 .jsonl；`store.rs:614-619` 压入全局事件环，`store.rs:201` `MAX_EVENTS: usize = 500`。**该环是全 3 个分类共用一条**（条目靠 `category_id` 区分），所以噪声会连带把其他分类的日志挤出去 —— 这点比发现里写的更严重。

4) 场景可达性确认（发现未说清、但成立）：同时满足「gate 已武装」+「全 Key 在熔断窗口内」需要一类**既武装 gate 又罚熔断**的失败。纯 5xx 不罚熔断（`proxy.rs:2340-2348` "5xx 一律不罚"）、429/408/409 也不罚（`TRANSIENT_4XX`，`proxy.rs:2333`），而硬 4xx（401 等）罚熔断但**不武装 gate**（`proxy.rs:1200-1206` `all_failed_is_hard_error` → `proxy.rs:1148-1158` 提前 return）。真正的触发面是**连接层失败**（断网/上游不可达/超时）：`proxy.rs:1105-1121` 里 `last_status=None`、`config_error=false`，`record_live_failure` 被无条件调用，尾部走 `proxy.rs:1163` `arm_all_failed_gate`。`health.rs:33/35` 阈值 3 次、窗口 60s，而 gate 每 5s 到期放行一次真实轮次 ⇒ 约 15s 断网后进入「60s 内每个请求都写一条重复事件」的稳定态。混合池（部分 Key 401 已熔断 + 最后一个连接失败）同样命中。

5) 附带的语义错误（发现未提，进一步证明非刻意）：这条文案是「已忽略熔断兜底重试（无处可切换）」，但在被短路的路径上**一次上游都没打**。日志断言了没有发生的动作，命中本项目忌讳的第 ④ 类。

6) 非误报为「刻意设计」：`proxy.rs:100-107` 明确把「白耗上游额度且刷爆日志」列为短路窗口的两个立项目标，本排序让第二个目标只完成一半；而项目对同类问题的既有标准就是「14 秒刷 12 条重复行」值得修（`store.rs:517-535` 折叠机制的立项理由）。
verdict.correction:
发现成立，但两处影响描述要改，修的时候别照抄理由：

① **「并 emit 一次 Logs 事件触发前端刷新」是错的**。`src-tauri/src/events.rs:104-109` `Topic::Logs => min_interval_ms = 1500`，外加 `events.rs:60` `COALESCE_MS = 250` 的批量合并窗口 —— 泵线程按 topic 合并且限流，前端刷新最坏 ≈ 1 次/1.5s，与事件条数无关。这条「触发前端重拉 500 条」的放大效应不存在，正是 `min_interval_ms` 当初为它设的。

② **「5s 窗口内 10~25 条」缺乏依据**。`proxy.rs:100-107` 里 0.2~0.5s 的实测间隔是**修复前**的现象（当时回 502/`api_error`、无 Retry-After）；现在短路回的是 529 + `Retry-After`（连接层失败无上游 hint ⇒ 取 `ALL_FAILED_SHORT_CIRCUIT_MS/1000` = 5s，`proxy.rs:1166-1168`）。遵守退避的客户端是 ~1 次/5s/链，量级由并发链数与不遵守退避的客户端决定，实际是「一个 60s 熔断窗口内几十条」而非「5s 内 10~25 条」。仍远超折叠阈值、仍是缺陷，但别按「秒级刷爆 500 环」定级。

③ 两处应补进描述：事件环 `MAX_EVENTS=500` 是**跨分类共享**（`store.rs:201`），噪声会挤掉其它分类的日志；以及文案在短路路径上**是假的**（声称已忽略熔断重试，实则零次上游调用）。

④ 修法取舍：优先「把 `proxy.rs:587` 的 gate 检查上移到 575 之前」——它同时消掉噪声与假文案；但**必须仍留在 `candidates.is_empty()` 检查（proxy.rs:569-574）之后**，否则全停用的池会从 503「无可用 Key」变成 529「过载请重试」，把用户能自助的配置问题伪装成上游问题。若选「加 collapse_key」方案，只压掉噪声、假文案仍在，且 `store.rs:926-937` `recent_failure` 认 kind=="failover"，分类页（`src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx:231-243`）仍会用这条模糊文案盖掉更有信息量的「全部 Key 失败: {last_err}」（`proxy.rs:1126`）。

confirmed.title: Chat → Responses 丢弃 response_format，结构化输出请求静默退化成自由文本
confirmed.scenario: Chat 下游客户端要结构化输出（`response_format:{"type":"json_object"}` 或 `{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{...}}`，这是 Chat API 里极常用的字段）→ Responses 协议 Key。`chat_to_responses` 从零重建 body，copy_through 白名单里没有 response_format，也没有映射到 Responses 的等价字段 `text.format` → 上游按自由文本回答 → 客户端 `JSON.parse` 失败，报错落在客户端侧，与「代理把字段吃了」毫无线索关联。Responses 协议**有**等价形态，属可映射而未映射（不同于 Anthropic 侧确实无等价物）。
confirmed.evidence: src-tauri/src/upstream/convert.rs:1395（copy_through 白名单只有 temperature/top_p/stream）；convert.rs:1325-1447 全函数无 response_format 处理；对照 Responses 的 `text.format` 字段。
confirmed.fix: 在 `chat_to_responses` 里把 `response_format` 映射成 `text: {"format": <原值>}`（json_object / json_schema 两种形态字段名一致）；反向 `responses_to_chat` 补 `text.format` → `response_format` 以保持往返对称。若判定本轮不做映射，则至少在目标为 Anthropic（确无等价物）时明确报错而非静默丢——否则又是一处「看起来配了、实际没用上」。

verdict.reason:
代码事实全部核实，但发现里的修复方案本身是错的（见 correction）。

**① 字段确实被丢弃，且丢得干净。** `response_format` / `json_object` / `json_schema` 在**全仓 0 次出现**（前后端一起 grep，只有无关的中文「结构化」注释命中）。`chat_to_responses`（convert.rs:1325-1447）从一个全新的 `serde_json::Map` 逐字段构建 `out`，插入点可穷举完：model(:1327)、instructions(:1387)、input(:1389)、max_output_tokens(:1393)、copy_through 三项(:1395)、reasoning(:1402/1404)、tools(:1426)、tool_choice(:1444) —— 无任何通配拷贝，故 `response_format` 必然不在输出里。

**② 转换后到发包前没有任何字段回填。** 非流式 proxy.rs:2109 转换 → :2166 `client.post(&url).json(&payload)`；流式 :1478 转换 → :1509 同理。中间只有 `ensure_anthropic_output_budget` / `strip_pending_effort`，不会把丢掉的键补回来。所以丢弃是终局的。

**③ 路径可达（需两个条件同时成立）。** `downstream_protocol`（proxy.rs:1844-1852）对既非 `/messages` 也非 `/responses` 的 path 一律判为 `Protocol::OpenaiChat`（proxy.rs:3077 自带用例 `("/v1/chat/completions", OpenaiChat, "OpenAI 兼容客户端")`），Key 协议与分类无绑定，故 `from=OpenaiChat, to=OpenaiResponses` → convert.rs:769 `chat_to_responses`。Chat 下游是**受支持且有测试用例的场景**（docs/07 用例 8.3、docs/08 R-3）。

**④ 不是刻意设计。** 同一批转换器对每个语义承载字段都补了显式映射，且注释明确记着「此前漏掉」的同类教训：`stop`↔`stop_sequences`(:331/:497)、`reasoning`(:998-1000「此前被丢弃导致『改了推理强度还走默认』」)、`tool_choice`(:1430「丢掉它会让『强制调用某工具』降级成自由选择」)。`response_format` 与这些同类、有等价物、却没进名单，也没有任何「刻意不带」的注释。

**⑤ 不良性。** 症状正是本项目列的忌讳形态④静默丢值不报错：上游按自由文本回答，客户端 `JSON.parse` 炸在自己那侧，与「代理吃了字段」零线索关联。

（补充：本想加临时探针实测，但同期有兄弟 agent 正在改 `proxy.rs`，`src/proxy.rs:5095` 处括号未闭合导致整个 crate 编译不过，无法跑 `cargo test`；我的临时改动已 `git checkout` 还原，convert.rs 现为干净状态。上述结论纯静态但可穷举、无歧义。）
verdict.correction:
**缺陷成立，但发现给的 fix 照抄会把静默降级变成硬 400，必须改。**

**1）「json_object / json_schema 两种形态字段名一致」是错的。** 实测官方文档（developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/structured-outputs）：Responses 的 `text.format` 是**扁平**的 —— `{"type":"json_schema","name":"…","schema":{…},"strict":true,"description":"…"}`；Chat 的 `response_format` 是**嵌套**的 —— `{"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{"name","schema","strict","description"}}`。所以 `text: {"format": <原值>}` 原样搬会发出一个带野生 `json_schema` 键、且缺必填 `name` 的 body，严格 Responses 上游直接 400（Unknown parameter: 'text.format.json_schema'）——**每个结构化输出请求都硬失败，比现在的静默降级更糟**。正确变换是把 `json_schema.*` 提一层上来，与 :1407-1428 对 `tools` 做的「Chat 嵌套 → Responses 扁平」拍平**完全同构**，照那段写即可。只有 `{"type":"json_object"}` 和 `{"type":"text"}` 两种形态才真的键名一致、可原样搬。

**2）漏了对称的另一半，且漏的那半更常走。** 发现只点了 `chat_to_responses`(:1395)。`responses_to_chat`(:997) 同样丢 `text.format` → Responses 下游客户端带结构化输出打到 Chat 协议 Key 时一样静默降级。而这个方向（Codex/Responses 下游 → 第三方 Chat 中转商）恰恰是本项目文档里的**主力场景**。两向要一起做，且反向要做**加一层嵌套**的逆变换，不是对称照搬。注意中枢设计下 Responses→Chat→Responses 往返不会发生（:729/:738 同协议短路直通），所以不存在「往返对称性」问题，只有两个独立方向各自的正确性。

**3）P3 的定级是对的，别往上抬。** 触发需要 `downstream=OpenaiChat` **且** `key.protocol=OpenaiResponses` 同时成立，而三个内置客户端**都产生不了**这个组合：ClaudeCli / ClaudeDesktop 发 `/v1/messages`（Anthropic），Codex 发 `/v1/responses`。必须是用户把一个通用 OpenAI-SDK 应用指到某个 SynaRoute 端口、且该分类当前 Key 是 Responses 协议。受支持、有用例，但不是任何出厂客户端的默认路径。

**4）「目标为 Anthropic 时明确报错」这条兜底建议不该做。** 为一个**可选**字段无等价物就 400 掉整个请求，会把现在能成功（且模型常常照 prompt 返回可用 JSON）的请求打死；更重要的是它与本仓统一约定相悖：四处 `copy_through`(:320/:464/:997/:1395) 都只透传同名采样字段，对 `n`/`seed`/`presence_penalty`/`frequency_penalty`/`logit_bias`/`logprobs`/`top_logprobs`/`user`/`parallel_tool_calls`/`stream_options`/`metadata`/`store` 等十余个无等价物字段一律静默丢。要可归因，正解是把「已丢弃的下游字段」记进请求日志 trace（用户能自查），而不是 4xx。

**5）顺带（不属本条，别混算）**：`text` 容器里的 `verbosity` 同样全仓无处理；`parallel_tool_calls`/`metadata`/`store`/`user`/`top_logprobs` 在两协议**同名**却没进 :1395 白名单，属同类「可映射未映射」，但都只是能力/质量退化，不像 `response_format` 会撕毁客户端的解析契约。

confirmed.title: loadCategory/refreshCategory 无代际校验：切分类时在途结果把上一分类的 keys/proxy 写进新分类页
confirmed.scenario: 在 claude-cli 页点某条 Key 的「上移」（moveKey 在函数头捕获 cat='claude-cli'）→ 立刻点侧栏切到 codex。upsert 全部 resolve 后 moveKey 执行 `await get().loadCategory('claude-cli')`，其 set 不做任何「当前分类是否还是它」的判断 → codex 页上列出 claude-cli 的 Key 卡片、状态条显示 claude-cli 的代理状态与端口。此时点状态条「停止」，stopProxy 用的是 get().activeCategory='codex'，停的不是屏幕上显示的那一条。同样的窗口存在于 setPrimaryKey(store.ts:514)、startProxy/stopProxy（store.ts:582-594、603-617，proxy 也被写成旧分类的值）。最长要等 30s 兜底轮询或下一次后端 config/proxy 推送才纠正。CategoryPage 已经为 takeover/recentFailure 专门做了 genRef 代际作废（并在注释里写明这类串台的后果），store 这一层却没有等价防线。
confirmed.evidence: src/store.ts:346-366 loadCategory 的 set 无分类校验；src/store.ts:368-383 refreshCategory 同样（`const c = get().activeCategory` 在 await 前取，set 时不再核对）；src/store.ts:196-199 setActiveCategory 是 `void get().loadCategory(c)`，多次快速切换会并发；src/store.ts:456-483 / 493-516 / 571-618 均在 await 前捕获 cat 后再 loadCategory(cat)；对比 src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx:79-96、111-118、160-171 的 genRef 代际校验
confirmed.fix: loadCategory(c)/refreshCategory 在最终 set 之前判 `if (c !== get().activeCategory) return;`（或加一个 store 级 generation 计数，切分类即递增、回来时对不上就丢弃），与 CategoryPage 的 genRef 同一模式；startProxy/stopProxy 写 proxy 时同样加这道判断。

verdict.reason: Mechanism verified, no guard exists. src/store.ts:348-368 loadCategory's final set (361-367) writes keys/proxy/brain/events with no check that c is still get().activeCategory; src/store.ts:370-385 refreshCategory captures c at :371 and sets after the await without re-checking; src/store.ts:196-199 setActiveCategory fires `void loadCategory(c)` with no cancellation/generation. Stale-bound callers capture cat before awaits then write it back unconditionally: moveKey :459→:484, setPrimaryKey :496→:516, startProxy :581→:585 (set({proxy})) and :595, stopProxy :606→:608 and :615 (finding missed switchToOfficial :623→:635/:640, same defect). The stale payload reliably wins because the action's loadCategory(old) starts AFTER the switch's loadCategory(new). Damage is full-list: src-tauri/src/store.rs:1370-1380 list_keys filters strictly by category, and CategoryPage.tsx:42-45,324 renders `keys` unfiltered while the header uses activeCategory (:184); App.tsx:153 renders one un-keyed CategoryPage so it never unmounts; Sidebar.tsx:68 has no disabled state so the switch is always clickable. No fast self-heal: usePolling deps are [intervalMs, enabled] (src/lib/usePolling.ts:56) so re-render does not re-fire it — correction only at the 30s FALLBACK_POLL_MS (src/lib/useBackendEvents.ts:18,:111-113; CategoryPage.tsx:39), the next backend config/proxy/health push (useBackendEvents.ts:88), or window refocus (App.tsx:95-112), so "最长 30s" is accurate. In-repo acknowledgment that this exact symptom is a real defect: CommandPalette.tsx:75-83, KeyEditor.tsx:632-635, docs/15-架构评审报告.md:496 (page-layer instance graded P2 and fixed via genRef at CategoryPage.tsx:79-96,111-118,160-171); no "刻意不做" entry covers the store layer (docs/15 §6.1-6.3 checked). Not deterministic though: the trigger window is the action's pre-loadCategory IPC span (tens of ms for moveKey; ~100ms-several hundred ms for startProxy/stopProxy/switchToOfficial per src-tauri/src/service.rs:71-87,:774-808), i.e. human-hittable but timing-dependent — hence medium confidence rather than high.
verdict.correction: Finding stands; two corrections, both making it worse rather than refuting it. (1) Severity is understated at P3: in the mismatched state setPrimaryKey filters keys by categoryId === activeCategory -> empty -> findIndex = -1 -> `idx <= 0` -> returns true (store.ts:500-502), and ProxyStatusBar.tsx:62-67 then shows showToast("success", "已切换主 Key: X") while nothing was persisted — a false-success + silent no-op (the project's forms 1 and 4), the same trap already documented in CommandPalette.tsx:75-83. That argues P2, matching docs/15:496's grading of the page-layer instance. (2) Scope is incomplete: switchToOfficial (store.ts:623 capture -> :635 set({proxy}) -> :640 loadCategory(cat)) has the identical defect and is not listed. Also note line citations run ~2 lines early (346-366 -> 348-368; 368-383 -> 370-385; 514 -> 516; 582-594 -> 581-595; 603-617 -> 606-615), and KeyEditor.tsx:620/:643 (frozen activeCategory) is NOT reachable the same way because the editor's `fixed inset-0` backdrop (:650) blocks sidebar clicks while it is open. toggleKey (:452) and deleteKey (:536) are correctly excluded — they read get().activeCategory live.

confirmed.title: 桌面端还原中途失败：with_rollback 回滚了文件却不回滚已删掉的 .synaroute-created 标记，此后永远还原不回「文件不存在」
confirmed.scenario: 用户从未装/打开过 Claude 桌面端 → 首次接入时两个 claude_desktop_config.json 都是 SynaRoute 凭空新建的，各留一个 .synaroute-created 标记。之后桌面端或 cc-switch 把 Claude-3p 的那份 config 写成了非法 JSON（或该文件被占用）。此时点「停止代理」：restore_desktop_steps 先对 normal_config 成功执行 restore_created_or_write_mode —— 删文件 + **删标记**（tools.rs:1639-1646）；紧接着对 threep_config 执行时 write_deployment_mode → read_json_or_empty 解析失败返回 Err。外层 with_rollback（tools.rs:1568-1576）只按内容快照恢复那 4 个文件，**不恢复标记**。于是 normal_config 内容回来了、它的 .synaroute-created 却永久消失。之后任何一次还原都走 write_deployment_mode 分支，在用户机器上留下一个 SynaRoute 自己造的 `{"deploymentMode":"1p"}` 文件冒充「用户的官方配置」，且再也没有路径能删掉它 —— 这正是 restore_created_or_write_mode 的注释所要避免的状态。同类残留还有 `configLibrary/_meta.json`：接入时凭空新建（含标记），还原时只把 entries 清空后写回、从不按标记删除，于是空 `{"entries":[]}` 与陈旧标记都长期留在用户的 Claude 目录里。
confirmed.evidence: src-tauri/src/tools.rs:1637-1650（restore_created_or_write_mode 先删文件再删标记，两步都在回滚保护之外）；tools.rs:1568-1576（with_rollback 只快照 4 个文件内容，不含 .synaroute-created / .synaroute.bak）；tools.rs:1729-1777（write_desktop_meta_clear_preferring 只改写 _meta，从不按 created 标记删除它）
confirmed.fix: 把标记纳入 with_rollback 的快照集合（把 created_marker_path_for(p) 也 push 进 paths），或让 restore_created_or_write_mode 改成两阶段：先把 4 个文件全部处理完再统一清标记；最简单的是先删标记再删文件改成「先删文件、标记留到 restore_desktop_steps 全部成功后再清」。_meta.json 同样应走 restore_created_or_write_mode 那条语义：清空后若 entries 为空且存在 created 标记，整文件删除。

verdict.reason:
机制成立，已用故障注入实测复现（临时测试跑完已删）。

证据链：
1) `with_rollback`（tools.rs:1318-1351）只对传入的 4 个路径拍**内容**快照（1323-1333）并按内容回滚（1339-1347）；`restore_desktop_at`（tools.rs:1568-1576）传入的正是 normal_config/threep_config/profile/meta 四条，**不含** `.synaroute-created` 标记路径。
2) `restore_created_or_write_mode`（tools.rs:1637-1650）在事务内部先 `remove_file(path)`（1641）再 `remove_file(marker)`（1643），两步都不在回滚保护内。
3) `restore_desktop_steps` 顺序为 profile 删除 → `_meta` 清理 → normal_config → threep_config（tools.rs:1594-1612）。因此存在一个真实窗口：**第一个 config 走标记分支成功（标记已删）、第二个 config 失败**。

- 失败后：`restore_desktop_at` 返回 Err；normal_config 内容被回滚成 SynaRoute 自己写的 `{"deploymentMode":"3p"}`，但 `created 标记 = false`、`.bak = false` —— 标记永久消失。

既有覆盖确认漏掉本场景：`desktop_restore_is_atomic_on_midway_failure`（tools.rs:4108-4159）把非法 JSON 注入的是**第一个** config（normal，4132-4133），失败发生在任何标记删除之前，故断言全过也抓不到这条。

非刻意设计：1628-1636 与 1552-1558 的注释表明作者意图恰恰相反（「整体原子」+「凭空新建须整份删除」）。P3 定级合理：残留物内容是 `deploymentMode:1p`（等同默认行为），无数据丢失、不构成用户死胡同，只是清理不净 + 语义被破坏。
verdict.correction:
需修正原发现三处：

1) **原文给的触发场景自相矛盾**：它设定「两个 config 都是凭空新建、各留一个标记」，却说 threep 那步是 `write_deployment_mode → read_json_or_empty 解析失败`。有标记时 `restore_created_or_write_mode`（tools.rs:1639-1647）直接走删除分支、**根本不解析 JSON**，非法 JSON 注入无着力点。真正可达的组合是**不对称**的：normal_config 凭空新建（有标记）+ threep_config 接入前已存在（有 `.bak`，无标记）。现实对应「cc-switch 用过 Claude-3p 目录、但 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json` 从未存在」，且 cc-switch 的 entry 已不在 `_meta`（否则 `others_remain=true`，整个块被跳过，tools.rs:1610）。
   「两个都凭空新建」的变体要靠 OS 级 `remove_file` 失败（真占用/ACL）。实测两点：把 threep 设**只读**不行——新版 Rust std 在 Windows 会清 readonly 属性照样删成功（还原整体返回 Ok）；把 threep 换成**目录**也不行——`with_rollback` 在快照阶段 `std::fs::read` 就失败（tools.rs:1325-1329），压根没进标记窗口。所以该变体的可复现性弱于原文描述。

2) **`_meta.json` 那半条：事实准确但不构成缺陷**。实测确认还原后 `_meta.json` 留下 `{"entries":[]}`、`_meta.json.synaroute-created` 标记永久残留（`write_desktop_meta_clear_preferring` tools.rs:1729-1777 从不按标记删文件）；profile 自己的 created 标记也从不清理（tools.rs:1594-1597 是裸 `remove_file`）。但这两处均无失败场景：空 entries + 无 appliedId 语义上等于「无配置档」，deploymentMode 已回 1p/已删，桌面端不受影响，且多轮接入-还原幂等不恶化。按「只报有可复现失败场景」的纪律，这半条应降为清理项，不与主条同级。

3) 原文修复建议里的顺序描述有误：现状是**先删文件再删标记**（tools.rs:1640-1645），不是「先删标记再删文件」。可行修法两条：把 `created_marker_path_for(p)` 一并放进 `restore_desktop_at` 的 with_rollback 路径集合（标记是空文件，快照代价为零）；或把标记清理延后到 `restore_desktop_steps` 全部成功之后统一做。

⚠️ 另需告知（与本发现无关的仓库状态）：验证期间有**并行会话**在本仓提交了 `aa0a6ac`，把我当时落在 `src-tauri/src/tools.rs` 的两个临时复现测试（`zz_repro_*`，57 行）一并 commit 进去了。我已从工作树删除，当前 `git diff` 就是这 57 行删除（`cargo test --lib desktop_restore` 6/6 通过），请让持有提交权的一方把这条删除并入提交，别把调试测试留在 master。

confirmed.title: 大脑页 Key 下拉的「已禁用」标注用全角括号硬编码，英文界面出现中文标点
confirmed.scenario: 英文界面下打开大脑聚合页，某条 Key 已停用 → 「添加成员」的 Key 下拉与「决策者 / 汇总模型」的 Key 下拉里显示 `MyKey（Disabled）`：括号是 U+FF08/U+FF09 全角括号，与英文文案混排。
confirmed.evidence: src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:762 `{key.enabled ? key.name : `${key.name}（${t("brain.keyDisabled")}）`}`；:893 同一写法（括号是字面量，只有括号里的词走了 t()）
confirmed.fix: 把整个后缀做成词条，如 `brain.keyDisabledSuffix`：zh="{name}（已禁用）" / en="{name} (disabled)"，两处改成 `t("brain.keyDisabledSuffix", { name: key.name })`。

verdict.reason:
Could not refute — every element of the claim is confirmed in source, and the project's own conventions/tests prove it is not intentional.

1) Code is exactly as claimed. `src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:762` and `src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:893` both render `{key.enabled ? key.name : `${key.name}（${t("brain.keyDisabled")}）`}`. The parentheses are U+FF08/U+FF09 literals baked into the template string; only the inner word goes through `t()`. Verified these are the only two full-width-paren occurrences on a render path in the file (all other `（` hits in BrainPage.tsx are inside `//` or `{/* */}` comments: :239, :378, :436-437, :498-499, :892).

2) The English render really does mix CJK punctuation. `src/lib/i18n.ts:444` zh = `"已禁用"`, `src/lib/i18n.ts:1220` en = `"disabled"` → English UI shows `MyKey（disabled）`.

3) English is a real, reachable UI language, not dead code: `src/lib/i18n.ts:5` `export type Lang = "zh" | "en"` and `src/lib/i18n.ts:7-10` `LANGS` contains `{ value: "en", label: "English" }`.

4) Not deliberate design — the project's established convention is the opposite. Parentheses are normally localized *inside* the dict value: `src/lib/i18n.ts:439` zh `"brain.selectPlaceholder": "（未选择）"` vs `src/lib/i18n.ts:1215` en `"(not selected)"` (half-width). `brain.keyDisabled` is the outlier where only the inner word was extracted and the wrapper was left hardcoded.

5) Not benign by the project's own standard. Grepping the entire `en` dict (i18n.ts:802-1571) for `（），、：「」` yields **0 hits** — these two JSX lines are the sole source of CJK glyphs in the English UI here. `src/lib/i18n.test.ts:11-17` explicitly names "英文界面露出中文" and "JSX 里不得硬编码中文文案" as the two failure classes i18n has tests for, and `src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx:300` documents a prior fix of exactly this class ("原先这里…都是硬编码中文，英文界面下会露出中文").

6) No automated guard catches it, so it will not self-surface: `src/lib/i18n.test.ts` implements only the key-symmetry test (:35) and the fallback test (:51). Principle 2 from its own header comment (JSX hardcoding) has **no** corresponding source-scan test, so these two lines pass CI unnoticed.

7) The proposed fix is implementable as written: `translate()` at `src/lib/i18n.ts:1574-1578` supports `{name}` placeholder interpolation (`raw.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, ...)`).
verdict.correction:
Finding stands as written; two refinements for whoever fixes it.

(a) Severity P3 / cosmetic-only is correct and should not be inflated. Full-width parens render fine and break neither layout nor function — the disabled marker is still legible in both languages. This is a localization-polish defect, not one of the project's four dreaded forms (no silent failure, no dead-end error, no front/back default mismatch, no silent truncation). The functional concern the two code comments at BrainPage.tsx:759-761 and :891-892 describe (users unknowingly picking a disabled Key) is genuinely handled — the marker is present in both languages.

(b) After introducing `brain.keyDisabledSuffix`, the old `brain.keyDisabled` key becomes fully unused — `grep -rn "keyDisabled" src/` shows its only two consumers are BrainPage.tsx:762 and :893. Delete it from **both** dicts (i18n.ts:444 and :1220), not just one: the key-symmetry test at i18n.test.ts:41-44 would flag a one-sided removal, while a two-sided leftover would pass silently as a dead entry.

Concretely: zh `"brain.keyDisabledSuffix": "{name}（已禁用）"` / en `"brain.keyDisabledSuffix": "{name} (disabled)"`, then both sites become `{key.enabled ? key.name : t("brain.keyDisabledSuffix", { name: key.name })}`.

confirmed.title: 计费倍率输入框零校验，非数字被后端静默按 1.0 计价，而用量页悬停提示仍回显原始串
confirmed.scenario: 在 Key 编辑器的「计费倍率」里填 `30%`（或用逗号小数 `0,3`、带全角字符）→ 保存不报任何错，config.json 里原样存下 `"costMultiplier": "30%"`。用量页算金额时 `"30%".parse::<f64>()` 失败 → 静默按 1.0（官方原价）估算，而同一格的悬停提示仍按原串渲染成「按官方单价表计算，倍率 30%」。用户看到「倍率 30%」，以为金额已是三折价，实际是原价，拿这个数去对账会差 3 倍多。
confirmed.evidence: src/components/KeyEditor.tsx:1371-1381（`value={costMultiplier}` + `onChange={e => setCostMultiplier(e.target.value)}`，无任何校验；:503 `costMultiplier: costMultiplier.trim() || undefined` 直接落盘）；src-tauri/src/pricing.rs:199-203（「倍率解析失败（用户填了 "abc"）时按 1.0」）；src-tauri/src/lib.rs:599-626 把原串作为 `multiplier` 回给前端；src/pages/UsagePage.tsx:307-311 + i18n "usage.costExactHint": "按官方单价表计算，倍率 {multiplier}"
confirmed.fix: KeyEditor 就地校验（`const n = Number(costMultiplier.trim()); Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0`），非法时输入框描红 + 给一句「只能填正数，如 0.3」并挡住保存（与 ContextWindowInput 的 invalidContextModels 同一模式）；或后端解析失败时把返回的 multiplier 也改成 "1.0" 并在该行加一个「倍率无效，已按原价估算」的警示。

verdict.reason:
每一条引用的证据都实读核对成立，且能构成完整的可复现链路，不是误读也不在「刻意不做」清单里。

1. 输入侧零校验（确认）：`src/components/KeyEditor.tsx:1371-1381` 是裸 `<input>`，无 `type="number"`、无 `pattern`、无 `inputMode`、无 `onBlur` 归一化，`onChange` 直接 `setCostMultiplier(e.target.value)`；初始化 `:178` 也只是 `useState(initial?.costMultiplier ?? "")`，无归一化。

2. 保存路径确认无任何一层拦截：前端 `save()` 在 `KeyEditor.tsx:581-599` 只校验 name / baseUrl / `isValidHttpUrl` / `invalidContextModels`（窗口与 maxout 分开报），**没有 costMultiplier 分支**；`:503` `costMultiplier: costMultiplier.trim() || undefined` 原样入草稿；后端 `src-tauri/src/service.rs:202-206` `save_key` 只做 `reject_desktop_key_with_unusable_model_names` + `warn_base_url_path_suffix_if_needed`；`src-tauri/src/store.rs:1393-1408` `upsert_key` 只补 uuid + 落盘。故 `"30%"` 原样进 config.json，全程零报错 —— 与发现描述一致。

3. 计价侧静默按 1.0（确认）：`src-tauri/src/pricing.rs:200-203` `multiplier.and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<f64>().ok()).filter(|m| *m > 0.0).unwrap_or(1.0)` —— `"30%"` / `"0,3"` 的 `parse::<f64>()` 均为 Err → 1.0（官方原价）。

4. UI 回显原串（确认，这是本条的要害）：`src-tauri/src/lib.rs:599-602` 取 `k.cost_multiplier.clone()` 未解析，`:615` `multiplier: mult` 把**原串**回给前端；`src/pages/UsagePage.tsx:305-311` 把它填进 `usage.costExactHint` / `usage.costFamilyHint`；`src/lib/i18n.ts:538`「按官方单价表计算，倍率 {multiplier}」、`:1313` 英文同义。→ 悬停提示明说「倍率 30%」，而金额实按 1.0 算，UI 自相矛盾且指向的是钱。命中项目最忌讳的形态 ④（静默用错值而不报错）与 ①（值落盘、后端无对应行为）。

5. 可达性确认：该字段位于 `balanceOpen` 折叠块（`KeyEditor.tsx:1084`）内、但在 `balance.enabled` 块（`:1105`~`:1367`）**之外**，即不开余额查询也能编辑，与 `:1369-1370` 的注释一致 —— 不是藏起来的死 UI。

6. 诱发概率被文案抬高：英文提示 `src/lib/i18n.ts:886-887` 字面含 "0.3 means 30% of list price"，用户照读回填 `30%` 是很自然的动作。

尝试推翻但未能推翻：`pricing.rs:199` 的注释「倍率解析失败（用户填了 "abc"）时按 1.0，不让一个笔误把金额算成 0」证明**兜底值本身是刻意设计**，因此不能以「后端应该报错/算 0」来定罪；但该注释只解决了「别算成 0」，完全没有覆盖「用户不知道自己的笔误未生效」，更没有授权 `lib.rs:615` 把未生效的原串当作生效倍率回显。用量页顶部虽有 `usage.estimateHint`「不是账单」的免责，但那免责的是「单价表 vs 实际计价」的偏差，挡不住「提示说的倍率与实算倍率不是同一个数」这种事实性矛盾。故 real=true。
verdict.correction:
发现成立，但有四点需要精确化，直接影响修法与定级：

(1) 修法不该动后端兜底。`src-tauri/src/pricing.rs:199` 的「解析失败按 1.0」有明确注释，是刻意设计，改成算 0 或返 Err 会撞既有意图。真正的缺陷面是「输入侧零校验」+「`src-tauri/src/lib.rs:615` 回显未生效的原串」这两处。发现给的两个修法都对，优先 KeyEditor 就地拦（与 `KeyEditor.tsx:592-599` invalidContextModels 同模式）；若要加后端兜底，正确改法是让 `lib.rs:599-615` 回显**实际生效**的倍率（解析成功回规范化值、失败回 `"1.0"`），而不是改 `estimate_cost` 的 fallback。

(2) 非法输入集比发现列的更宽，校验条件必须是 `Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0`（发现给的正好对）：`"0"` / `"-1"` 能 parse 成功但被 `pricing.rs:202` 的 `.filter(|m| *m > 0.0)` 滤掉，走**同一条**静默 1.0 路径；反向地 `"inf"` / `"1e400"` 在 Rust 里 `parse::<f64>()` 是 Ok(inf) 且过得了 `> 0.0` 过滤，一路到 `pricing.rs:73` `(base as f64 * multiplier).round() as u64` —— Rust as-cast 饱和到 `u64::MAX`，金额列会显示约 184.4 亿美元。这是同一处零校验的第二个出口，仅描红「只能填正数」还不够，必须同时挡非有限值。

(3) 爆炸半径确认是封闭的，仅限用量页估算。全仓 grep `cost_multiplier` 的**唯一**读取点是 `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:601`（`get_usage_with_cost`）；其余 20 处全是测试 fixture 的 `cost_multiplier: None`（health.rs / proxy.rs / portable.rs / aggregate.rs / upstream/budget.rs 等）。转发、故障转移、预算（`upstream/budget.rs`）都不读它，故**不会**影响路由或任何计费执行，只影响一个标注为估算的显示值。

(4) 定级：P3 站得住（无数据丢失、无转发影响、有页面级免责声明），但「提示明说的倍率不是实算倍率」这一点按项目自己的红线（静默用错值 / 值落盘无行为）可以论证到 P2。发现 scenario 里「拿这个数去对账会差 3 倍多」略偏重 —— 用量页 `usage.estimateHint` 已声明「不是账单」，真实伤害应表述为「UI 声称的倍率与实算倍率不一致，用户误以为已校准过折扣」。

confirmed.title: 大脑页首屏三个 IPC 用 Promise.all 且无 catch，任一失败即永久停在「加载中…」，无错误态无重试
confirmed.scenario: 进大脑页（或切分类）时，`Promise.all([getBrainConfig, listKeys, getToolConfigPreview])` 只有 .then 没有 .catch。任一 IPC 抛错 → config 保持 null → 组件走 :176-183 的分支永久渲染「加载中…」，页面上没有任何错误文字、也没有重试按钮，用户唯一的自救路径是猜到要切一次分类。可触发的抛错点：桌面端预览的 `claude_desktop_dirs()`（定位不到 %LOCALAPPDATA% 时 Err）、Codex 预览的 `codex_config_path()`（定位不到 home 时 Err）。这条风险后端注释里已明确点出过并只在后端一侧做了防线。
confirmed.evidence: src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:51-62（`void Promise.all([...]).then(([cfg, ks, preview]) => {...})`，无 .catch，也无 error state）；src-tauri/src/tools.rs:1941-1943 注释：「读取失败不上抛：…而非让整份预览返回 Err、前端丢掉全部路径、**聚合页永久卡「加载中」**」；src-tauri/src/tools.rs:377 与 :155 仍会返回 Err；对比 CategoryPage.tsx:111-118 对同一个 getToolConfigPreview 显式加了 .catch
confirmed.fix: 改用 Promise.allSettled，让 getToolConfigPreview 失败只把 mcpRegistered 置 null（按钮已有 `mcpRegistered == null` 的 disabled 处理），不拖垮 config；再加一个 loadError state，失败时渲染错误文案 + 「重试」按钮。

verdict.reason:
Every structural claim checks out verbatim, but the cited trigger is practically unreachable — so this is a real latent gap, not a live user-facing bug.

CONFIRMED:
1. `src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:51-62` — `void Promise.all([api.getBrainConfig(category), api.listKeys(category), api.getToolConfigPreview(category)]).then(([cfg, ks, preview]) => {...})`. No `.catch`, no error state, no cleanup, no generation guard.
2. `src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:176-183` — `if (!config)` renders `BrainHeader` + `{t("common.loading")}` with no error text and no retry control. Reject → `config` stays null → permanent 「加载中…」.
3. Only one of the three IPCs is fallible: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:404` `fn get_brain_config(...) -> BrainConfig` and `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:56` `fn list_keys(...) -> Vec<ProviderKey>` are **non-Result**; `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:497` `fn get_tool_config_preview(...) -> AppResult<ToolConfigPreview>` is the sole Err source.
4. No global safety net: `grep` for `unhandledrejection` / `ErrorBoundary` / `componentDidCatch` across `src/` returns **zero hits**. So the rejection is truly silent (console only).
5. The backend comment the reporter quotes is real and names this exact symptom: `src-tauri/src/tools.rs:1941-1943` — 「…而非让整份预览返回 Err、前端丢掉全部路径、**聚合页永久卡「加载中」**」. `read_preview_text` (`:1937-1971`) does honor it (both branches return `Ok`), but the path-resolution half still bails: `src-tauri/src/tools.rs:155` (`codex_config_path` → `dirs::home_dir().ok_or_else(...)`), `:377` (`claude_desktop_dirs` → `data_local_dir().ok_or_else(...)`), `:75` (`claude_cli_settings_path`). So the frontend half of an already-acknowledged risk was never built.
6. BrainPage:55 is the lone outlier against the repo's own convention: `src/store.ts:351` and `:373` use `Promise.allSettled`, `src/components/CommandPalette.tsx:118-119` uses `allSettled`, `src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx:111-118` puts an explicit `.catch` on this very same `getToolConfigPreview` call. Even `save()` in the same file (`BrainPage.tsx:102-112`) catches and toasts.
7. The proposed fix's premise holds: `BrainPage.tsx:221` already has `disabled={mcpBusy || mcpRegistered == null}`, so degrading `mcpRegistered` to null is safe.

WHY ONLY MEDIUM: the two triggers the reporter names are not reproducible on the supported platform. `dirs = "5"` (`src-tauri/Cargo.toml:73` → dirs 5.0.1 / dirs-sys 0.4.1) implements Windows `home_dir()` as `known_folder_profile()` and `data_local_dir()` as the LocalAppData known folder — both return `None` only if `SHGetKnownFolderPath` fails, i.e. a profile so broken the app couldn't have started. I audited every other `?` in the preview chain and found no reachable Err: `read_preview_text` swallows read failures, `is_mcp_registered` (`tools.rs:950-968`) and `json_has_mcp_server` (`:971-980`) use `let Ok(..) else { return false }` throughout, `detect_desktop_takeover_at` returns `Option`, `codex_config_path` short-circuits on `CODEX_HOME` without erroring. The one genuinely designed-to-fire path is `src/lib/bridge.ts:62-66` (production build where `isTauri()` misdetects), whose message was authored to reach the user — 「请重启应用；若持续出现请反馈此错误」 — and which this page uniquely swallows while other pages toast it.

Verdict: real defect in form (fallible IPC with zero error surface, matching the project's banned form ②「报错指向用户无法自助的死胡同」), P3 is the right severity, but it should be filed as a defensive gap, not sold as a reproducible failure.
verdict.correction:
Three corrections to the finding as written:

1. Downgrade the scenario's reachability. `claude_desktop_dirs()` / `codex_config_path()` returning Err requires `dirs::data_local_dir()` / `dirs::home_dir()` to return `None`, which on Windows (dirs 5.0.1, `src-tauri/Cargo.toml:73`) means `SHGetKnownFolderPath` failed. Not user-reproducible. The reachable-by-design rejection is `src/lib/bridge.ts:62-66`, not the dirs calls. Keep the fix (it's 3 lines, zero risk, and closes the frontend half of the defense the backend author explicitly wrote at `tools.rs:1941-1943`), but don't claim a live failing scenario.

2. Narrow the fix. `getBrainConfig` and `listKeys` are **infallible** Tauri commands (`lib.rs:404`, `lib.rs:56` — plain return types, not `AppResult`). So `allSettled` only buys anything for the third element; the `loadError` state should be driven by the whole batch (to cover bridge-level throws) while `getToolConfigPreview` failure alone degrades to `mcpRegistered = null`.

3. There is a **more reachable defect in the same effect/handler that the finding missed** — the exact 串台 class CLAUDE.md says was already fixed twice elsewhere:
   - `src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:51-62` has **no generation guard** and, unlike `config`/`saved`/`mcpRegistered`, does **not** reset `keys` on category change.
   - `src/pages/BrainPage.tsx:84-94` `checkKeyHealth` closes over `category` from the render where the user clicked, `await api.checkHealth(keyId)` (network, seconds), then unconditionally `const fresh = await api.listKeys(category); setKeys(fresh);` in a `finally`.
   - Repro: on the 大脑 page, click a Key's 健康检测 (`BrainPage.tsx:317` / `:776-779`) against a slow/unreachable endpoint, then switch the category tab in `BrainHeader` while it's in flight. The stale `listKeys(oldCategory)` result lands in `keys` **after** the new category's `Promise.all` resolved → the member picker now lists the previous category's Keys under the new category. Adding members from that list writes foreign `keyId`s into the new category's `BrainConfig`, and `save_brain` (`src-tauri/src/store.rs:2129-2138`) keys off `brain.category_id`, so they persist into the wrong category as permanently unresolvable members.
   - `src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx:79/84/110/114/161/166` shows the established remedy (`genRef` generation check) with a comment describing precisely this hazard. BrainPage never adopted it.
   Also minor, same handler: `checkKeyHealth`'s rejection is unhandled (no `.catch` at `:317`), and with no `unhandledrejection` listener anywhere in `src/`, a failed health check produces no user-visible signal.

confirmed.title: 「今日/本周/本月」只读已落盘日桶，不含尚未 flush 的增量（后端注释声称前端会相加，实际没有）
confirmed.scenario: 新装或跨零点后发起第一次请求，立刻打开用量页：表格行与 estCost 立刻有数（走 token_usage_by_key 内存累加器），而顶部「今日」仍是 0、近 7 日趋势今天那根柱子仍是最小底座，要等最多 60s 的定时 flush 才跳上来。用户看到同一页里「明细有 12k、今日 0」的自相矛盾，最容易的解读是统计坏了。
confirmed.evidence: src/pages/UsagePage.tsx:97-104（periods 全部取自 byDate，byDate 只由 api.getDailyUsage() 的日桶构成，没有把 rows 的实时量并进当天）；后端 src-tauri/src/store.rs:1884-1888 的文档却写「面板的「今日」由前端把这份历史与 token_usage_by_key 的实时增量相加得出，故这点延迟不会让用户看到停滞的数字」——这个前提没有实现。
confirmed.fix: 要么前端把 rows 相对当日桶的差额并进 today（需后端额外给出 baseline 才能算准），要么让 get_daily_usage 在返回前先做一次 flush_usage_if_dirty（或就地把内存增量合成进当天桶再返回）；同时修掉 store.rs:1884-1888 那段与实现不符的注释。

verdict.reason:
All four load-bearing claims check out; I could not refute it.

1) `periods` is derived exclusively from `byDate`: `src/pages/UsagePage.tsx:97-106` reads only `byDate.get(...)`, and `byDate` (`:85-95`) is built only from `daily`, which is set only from `api.getDailyUsage()` (`:41-48`). The live `rows` array is never folded in — it feeds only `summary` (`:64-77`) and the table (`:219-244`).

2) The daily buckets genuinely exclude unflushed usage. `daily_buckets` has exactly one mutation site in the whole crate — `src-tauri/src/store.rs:1806`, inside `flush_usage_if_dirty` (grep for `daily_buckets` shows every other hit is a decl/load/clone/test). The hot path only touches the flat accumulator and flips a dirty flag: `src-tauri/src/store.rs:575-580` (`usage_totals.write()...add(u); self.mark_usage_dirty();`). `get_daily_usage` (`src-tauri/src/lib.rs:560-562`) does zero flushing — it is a bare `self.daily_buckets.read().clone()` (`store.rs:1888`). Flush is a fixed 60 s background timer (`store.rs:169` `USAGE_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECS: u64 = 60`; `lib.rs:1341-1352`).

3) Meanwhile the table IS live: `get_usage_with_cost` (`lib.rs:588-589`) → `token_usage_by_key()` → `usage_totals` (`store.rs:859-869`), written synchronously per request at `store.rs:577`.

4) The false invariant is real and it is duplicated. `store.rs:1885-1887` claims "面板的「今日」由前端把这份历史与 `token_usage_by_key` 的实时增量相加得出，故这点延迟不会让用户看到停滞的数字" — no such addition exists. Ruled out as intentional design: the comment does not describe the lag as accepted, it asserts a compensating mechanism that was never implemented.

Reproducible: fresh install → make one request → open usage page. Table row and `estCost` are populated; `今日` renders 0 and today's trend bar sits at the hardcoded 2px floor (`UsagePage.tsx:175`).

Ruled out a worse adjacent bug while verifying: `usage_baseline` is correctly seeded from loaded totals in both constructors (`store.rs:408` and `store.rs:2682`), so the first flush does not dump all-time history into today's bucket.
verdict.correction:
Finding is valid at P3, but four things need correcting/extending:

1. **The bad comment is in two places, not one.** Besides `src-tauri/src/store.rs:1885-1887`, the identical false claim is on the IPC command itself: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:556-558` — "面板把这份历史与 `get_token_usage` 的实时总量配合使用，故这点延迟不会让「今日」看起来停滞。" Fixing only `store.rs` leaves the lie on the command a maintainer actually reads first.

2. **Worst-case window is ~90 s, not 60 s.** The 60 s flush timer (`lib.rs:1345-1348`) stacks with UsagePage's own 30 s poll (`UsagePage.tsx:58`). Also the flush thread's first tick is 60 s *after app start* (`sleep` precedes the flush in the loop), so a request made in the first minute of a run waits for that tick regardless.

3. **The finding's frontend-side fix option is not viable as written, and its `flush_usage_if_dirty` option is the worse of the two.** `rows` are all-time cumulative *including cross-restart history* loaded from `usage.json` (`store.rs:859-869`, totals seeded at `store.rs:402`), while `byDate` is per-day — so "把 rows 相对当日桶的差额并进 today" would add historical total minus today's bucket, producing a wildly inflated "今日" on any install with history. And calling `flush_usage_if_dirty` from `get_daily_usage` turns the panel's 30 s poll into a disk write, which directly contradicts the deliberate "空闲的应用一个字节都不写盘 / 用户明确关心过 SSD 写入寿命" design at `store.rs:86-90`, and still fixes nothing in read-only mode (see 4). The correct fix is purely in-memory and server-side: have `daily_usage_buckets()` (`store.rs:1888`) merge `usage_totals − usage_baseline` into today's bucket on the returned clone, reusing the same delta math as `flush_usage_if_dirty` (`store.rs:1774-1800`), with no write and no baseline mutation.

4. **The auditor missed the non-self-healing variant of the same gap.** When `usage_read_only` is true — disk `usage.json` has a higher format version than the running program, i.e. after a downgrade — `flush_usage_if_dirty` returns early forever at `store.rs:1758-1760`. `daily_buckets` then never receives *any* of that session's usage, so 今日/本周/本月 and the entire 7-day trend stay frozen for the whole session while the table keeps climbing. That is the permanent form of this bug and it will not resolve on its own, which strengthens the case for the in-memory-merge fix (it works in read-only mode; flushing does not).

One framing caveat: the "同一页里明细有 12k、今日 0" contradiction is only sharp on a fresh install, where cumulative == today. On an install with history the table is explicitly labeled 累计自 X 起 (`UsagePage.tsx:130-134`), so large-table/zero-today is not self-evidently wrong to the user; there the noticeable symptom is narrower — today's trend bar staying at the 2px floor immediately after a request.

confirmed.title: 90 天滚动删桶后，重启会让「累计用量」数字回退，而「统计自 X 起」仍显示最初日期
confirmed.scenario: 连续使用超过 90 天：某次 flush 删掉 91 天前的桶（:1842-1854），本次运行内存里的 usage_totals 仍含那部分历史、面板数字正常；下次重启时 load_usage 用「剩余日桶求和」重建 totals（:1712-1720），被删掉的那段历史随之从累计里消失 → 用量页总计与 estCost 一夜之间变小，而 since_ms 从不推进，标题仍写「统计自 <首次使用日> 起」。一个自称累计的面板数字往回走，正是 token_usage_totals_never_shrink_when_event_ring_rotates 那条测试想防的现象，只是尺度换成了 90 天。
confirmed.evidence: src-tauri/src/store.rs:1842-1854（cutoff 删桶）与 src-tauri/src/store.rs:1712-1720（重启时 totals 只由 daily_buckets 求和重建）；since_ms 在 :1853-1861 的快照里原样沿用，无任何随裁剪推进的逻辑。附带同类：v1 文件的历史 entries 在首次 flush 时既不进日桶也不再写回（:1858 `entries: Vec::new()`），故老用户升级后累计同样一次性归零 —— 该行为已被 store.rs:3327-3338 的断言固化，但 src-tauri/src/model.rs:1396-1399 的文档仍写「首次 flush 时把 v1 的 entries 全搬进一个桶」，两者矛盾。
confirmed.fix: 裁剪时把被删桶的量并进一个「lifetime_totals」字段（或同步把 since_ms 推进到最老保留桶的日期，让标题与数字自洽）；顺带把 model.rs:1396-1399 的 v1→v2 迁移描述改成与实现一致的说法。

verdict.reason: 机制四条腿全部核实，无一误读，且无任何「刻意设计」痕迹。① 裁剪确实发生：store.rs:1843-1854 `cutoff_ms = now_ms - 90*86_400_000` 只 retain 新桶，且只动 `daily_buckets`，不动 `usage_totals`（store.rs:85），故本次运行内数字仍完整。② 重启时累计确实只由桶重建：store.rs:1705-1713 遍历 `daily_buckets` 求和，而 store.rs:1864 每次 v2 flush 都写 `entries: Vec::new()`，磁盘上不存在任何独立的 lifetime 字段。③ `since_ms` 确实永不推进：`grep usage_since_ms.write()` = 0 处，全部出现点只有 store.rs:405/2678（构造时从盘读）、1769（读出再写回）、1901（getter），故 store.rs:1861 永远原样回写首次日期。④ UI 确实把它当终身累计呈现：UsagePage.tsx:130-134 把 `usage.since` + sinceMs 直接放在累计表上方，i18n.ts:513「跨重启累计」、:533「累计花费（估算）」，而 usage.sinceHint（:525）只讲 1 分钟落盘窗口，无任何滚动窗口提示。契约在代码里也是白纸黑字：store.rs:108「`usage_totals` = **跨全部历史的总量**」。反面证据检索无果：docs/17-用量查询与悬浮窗方案.md:168 把 90 天保留期明确限定在「按日汇总…避免 usage.json 无限增长」，从未把终身累计纳入该窗口。附带的 v1 子结论同样成立且更紧迫（无需 90 天，一次升级 + 一次重启即触发）：UsageLoad 的字段注释 store.rs:142-145 声称 v1 历史「只体现在 totals 里」，但 totals 不是独立持久化字段，故 store.rs:1864 首次 flush 即销毁；store.rs:3334-3337 的断言 `restored == 200` 把这条数据丢失固化成期望行为；model.rs:1397-1398 的迁移描述（「全搬进一个桶，日期按 since_ms 推算」）与实现及 store.rs:3293-3308 的测试注释直接矛盾。命中项目最忌讳的第 ④ 类（静默用错值而不报错）。
verdict.correction:
发现成立，按原方案修（裁剪时把被删桶量并进独立持久化的 lifetime_totals，或同步把 since_ms 推进到最老保留桶日期让标题与数字自洽）。修的时候补三点：

1) **v1 那半段优先级应高于 90 天那半段**，别当「附带」。它不需要跑满 90 天：v1 用户升级后一次 flush（≤60s）+ 一次重启，攒了几个月的累计就归零，而「统计起点」仍写升级前的老日期。且 store.rs:3334-3337 的断言已把它固化成期望行为，改实现时必须同步改这条测试，否则会被误当回归拦下来。

2) **同区域还有第三处矛盾文档需一并订正**：store.rs:850-857 `token_usage_by_key` 的注释仍写「口径为『本次运行累计』…**刻意不含跨天历史、不落盘**…重启归零已在副标题里明说」——落盘功能上线后即失效，且与 store.rs:108「跨全部历史的总量」和现副标题 i18n.ts:513「跨重启累计」互相打脸。三处说法（本次运行 / 跨全部历史 / 跨重启）必须收敛成一个。

3) 两处对发现本身的精度修正，均不改变判定：
   - store.rs:1842 注释「删掉 91 天前的桶」措辞不准。`cutoff_ms` 含当天时刻分量，与桶的零点毫秒比较，故**恰好 90 天前**那个桶一过零点即被删，实际保留 T-89..T 共 90 个桶。有效窗口与设计一致，只是注释口径松，可顺手改成「保留最近 90 天」。
   - 数字不是一次性断崖，而是**每次重启削掉新裁剪的那几天**，稳态下每次掉约一天的量。这让它比断崖更难被用户发现（面板只是缓慢下漂），因此不该因为「掉得少」而降级处理。

confirmed.title: proxy_running_categories 既没在导出时剔除、也没在导入时保留，导入别人的配置可能让下次启动自动起代理并改写本机客户端配置文件
confirmed.scenario: strip_machine_local 逐条剔掉 proxy_ports / mcp_* / log_dir / auto_start，apply_imported_config 又把这 6 项从当前值继承回来，但**漏了 proxy_running_categories**（它同样是 #[serde] 落盘的后端自管运行态，model.rs:1707-1717 明确「由 set_proxy_running_categories 更新，不在 UserPrefs 白名单里」）。场景：A 机导出时 ClaudeCli+Codex 两个代理在跑；B 机只用过 ClaudeCli、从没启动过 Codex 代理。B 导入该文件 → cfg.settings.proxy_running_categories 被写成 ["claude-cli","codex"]。若 B 在下一次周期性快照（60s）与优雅退出之前被强杀 / 崩溃 / 断电，这个值就留在盘上；下次启动 restore_proxies_on_launch 会对 Codex 走 apply_tool_config —— 即「起监听 + 写客户端配置」，把用户 ~/.codex 的配置改成指向 SynaRoute 代理，而用户从未开启过 Codex 分类。方向反过来（文件里是空集）则是 B 的「一直开着」被清掉。因 60s 快照与退出钩子会覆盖，触发需要非优雅退出，故窗口有限。
confirmed.evidence: src-tauri/src/portable.rs:173-181 strip_machine_local 未清 proxy_running_categories；src-tauri/src/store.rs:1257-1267 apply_imported_config 显式继承 6 个本机字段、无这一项；src-tauri/src/model.rs:1707-1717 该字段的后端自管声明；src-tauri/src/service.rs:1006-1019 restore_proxies_on_launch 走 apply_tool_config（会写客户端配置）
confirmed.fix: strip_machine_local 里加 `s.proxy_running_categories.clear();`，apply_imported_config 里加 `incoming.proxy_running_categories = cfg.settings.proxy_running_categories.clone();`，并在 machine_local_settings_are_stripped_on_export_and_preserved_on_import 那条测试里补上对应断言（它已覆盖另外 5 项，加一行即可防回归）。

verdict.reason: 代码逐条核实，四个关键论断全部成立。①portable.rs:173-181 strip_machine_local 只清 6 个字段（proxy_ports/mcp_registered_categories/mcp_port/mcp_enabled/log_dir/auto_start），无 proxy_running_categories；且该函数全仓只有一处调用（portable.rs:200，build_export 内），不存在第二道净化。②model.rs:1716-1717 该字段是 `#[serde(default, deserialize_with = "de_category_vec")]`，无 skip_serializing → 确实被写进 ExportPayload.settings。③store.rs:1260-1267 apply_imported_config 从 payload 建 incoming，只把那同样 6 个字段继承回来（:1261-:1266），随后 `cfg.settings = incoming`（:1267），整个动作在 mutate_and_persist 内 → 导入值立刻落盘。④service.rs:1006-1019 restore_proxies_on_launch 读该字段逐个走 apply_tool_config，而 apply_tool_config 就是 `proxy.start()` + `crate::tools::apply(...)`（service.rs:76-85），会改写客户端自己的配置文件；后果由项目自身文档钉住在 service.rs:156-158：「Codex 那边 auth.json 会被整份换成占位 key（原 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态被挪进 .bak）… 此后每次开应用都自动拉起并重写配置 —— 用户从未点过启动」。自愈边界与发现所述一致、并不更宽：lib.rs:1355 后台线程每 USAGE_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECS=60（store.rs:169）调 snapshot_running_proxies，lib.rs:1554 的 RunEvent::Exit 在 stop_all 前再快照一次，两者都用 ProxyManager 活真相覆盖（set_proxy_running_categories，store.rs:2353-2365，集合不同即写）；关窗只是隐藏到托盘、60s 循环继续纠正。故留脏只发生在导入后 ≤60s 内被强杀/崩溃/断电，用 taskkill /F 可确定性复现，但窗口确实有限 —— P3 定级恰当，不应更高。测试缺口也证实：portable.rs:844-902 那条测试导出侧断言 5 项（:861-868）、防篡改导入侧断言 4 项（:886-897），独独没有 proxy_running_categories；该测试在 :881-883 刻意绕过 parse_and_verify 来验证导入侧是独立防线，说明发现提出的「两侧都补」是沿用既有纵深模式而非冗余。
verdict.correction: 发现基本准确，仅两点补充/校准。（1）发现未提到的一条加强证据：在所有「后端自管」设置字段里，proxy_running_categories 是**唯一**残留的纯本机运行态。active_models / active_efforts / onboarding_done 都是用户可感语义、随导出走是对的；只有它是对本进程运行态的采样快照，因此漏剔不是取舍问题，而是与它自己在 model.rs:1701-1715 声明的契约自相矛盾。（2）触发条件需要说清、别夸大：优雅退出（托盘「退出」走 RunEvent::Exit，lib.rs:1554）与 60s 周期快照（lib.rs:1355）都会覆盖成真实运行集，关闭窗口只是隐藏到托盘、后台循环照常纠正。所以这不是「导入即中毒」，而是「导入后 60s 内非优雅终止才留脏」。修复方案本身正确：portable.rs strip_machine_local 内加 `s.proxy_running_categories.clear();`，store.rs:1266 后加 `incoming.proxy_running_categories = cfg.settings.proxy_running_categories.clone();`，并在 portable.rs:844 那条测试的两组断言里各补一行防回归。

confirmed.title: 日志保留期清理只在启动时跑一次，常驻/自启动实例永不清理，30 天保留期对最需要它的场景失效
confirmed.scenario: 用户开启「开机自启动」（FR-025，已实现），机器长期不关、应用最小化到托盘常驻 45 天不重启。写线程每天跨 UTC 零点新开一个 `YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`，于是目录里攒下 45 个文件，其中 15 个已超过 LOG_RETAIN_DAYS=30 却永远不会被删 —— 因为 cleanup_old_logs 的唯一调用点在 lib.rs:1273（进程启动路径）。LOG_RETAIN_DAYS 的注释说这道清理是为了防「长期运行一年就攒 365 个文件」，而长期运行恰恰是它唯一失效的场景。开了「调用模型日志」时单日文件可到数百 MB（每行含 2×20000 字符正文），磁盘占用也不受约束。
confirmed.evidence: src-tauri/src/store.rs:667 `pub fn cleanup_old_logs(&self)` 文档写「启动时调一次」；src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1273 `store.cleanup_old_logs();` 是全仓唯一调用点（grep 确认）；src-tauri/src/store.rs:194-201 LOG_RETAIN_DAYS 的理由注释；src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1338-1351 已存在一个 60s 周期的后台 tick（flush_usage_if_dirty），可直接搭车。
confirmed.fix: 在 lib.rs:1338 那个既有后台 tick 里记住「上次清理的 UTC 日期」，日期变了就调一次 `store.cleanup_old_logs()`（best-effort，失败只 warn）。不必新起线程，也不必改成配置项。

verdict.reason: 机制部分逐条实测成立，不是误读：(1) `store.cleanup_old_logs()` 在全仓**只有一个调用点**，且位于进程启动路径 —— `src-tauri/src/lib.rs:1273`（`grep -rn cleanup_old_logs` 全仓仅命中 lib.rs:1273 与 store.rs:667 定义 + store.rs:3746 单测）。(2) 写线程确实按 UTC 日期滚文件、跨天即重开：`src-tauri/src/store.rs:738` `let date = chrono::Utc::now().format("%Y-%m-%d")`，`:741` `dt != &date` 触发 `need_reopen`，`:753` `dir.join(format!("{date}.jsonl"))`。清理侧 cutoff 同样用 UTC（`store.rs:672`），两侧口径一致，所以这里**没有**额外的差一天问题。(3) 没有任何其他兜底：`remove_file` 在非测试代码里不涉及日志目录，无总量上限、无单文件上限、改日志目录也不触发清理。(4) 常驻场景真实存在：FR-025 自启动已接线（`lib.rs:1372` `tauri_plugin_autostart::init`，`lib.rs:1404` 按 `--autostart` 最小化到托盘），托盘常驻 + 笔记本每晚只睡眠不重启的话进程连续存活数月是很平常的，30 天以上运行时长并不罕见。(5) 现成载体确实在：`lib.rs:1340-1359` 的固定节奏后台 tick，周期 `USAGE_FLUSH_INTERVAL_SECS = 60`（`store.rs:169`），且该 tick 里已按同样理由搭过两趟车（`flush_usage_if_dirty` / `snapshot_running_proxies`），再搭一趟与既有风格一致。(6) 也不是「刻意设计」：`store.rs:659` 的「启动时调一次」只是描述调用约定，没有任何注释论证过「刻意不做周期清理」（对比 CLAUDE.md 里明确标注为刻意例外的 `update_health`）。判 P3 而非更高、confidence 给 medium 的原因：后果是「运行期间多攒文件 + 占盘」，下次启动即被完整清掉、不丢数据、无用户可见死胡同，属于真实但轻微的管家活缺口，且 finding 的量级描述有夸大（见 correction）。
verdict.correction:
缺陷成立，但有三处需要收敛，另有一处 finding 漏掉的**同函数真实缺口**，修的时候应一并处理：

1. **不是永久泄漏，会自愈**：文件数上界 = 本次连续运行天数，且下次启动 `lib.rs:1273` 一跑就把超期的全删掉。finding 里「永远不会被删」只在**该进程存活期间**成立，不是跨重启的永久积累。

2. **「长期运行恰恰是它唯一失效的场景」是修辞**：`store.rs:191-193` 那句「长期运行一年就攒 365 个文件」在语义上更像「长期使用（含多次重启）」，而这个场景启动清理是**管得住的**。真正失效的是「单次进程连续运行 > 30 天」这个更窄的子集。

3. **量级夸大**：`store.rs:192` 自己的估算是 trace 关时约 250 KB/天；trace 开时单条上限约 2×20000 字符 ≈ 40 KB（`store.rs:804`、`proxy.rs:649`），要到「单日数百 MB」需要每天数千次满载 trace 的请求，属极端上界而非常态。「磁盘占用不受约束」的说法应改成「上界随运行时长线性增长，无独立的体积上限」。

4. **finding 漏掉的一条（更值得修，因为它不自愈）**：`cleanup_old_logs` 只扫**当前生效**的日志目录 —— `store.rs:668` `let dir = self.effective_log_dir();`，而 `effective_log_dir`（`store.rs:2218-2223`）只返回 `settings.log_dir` 或默认目录。用户在设置里改过日志目录后，**旧目录里的历史 `YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl` 再也不会被任何代码清理**，重启也不会（新目录才被扫）。这条是真正永不自愈的残留，和本 finding 是同一处代码、同一次修改就能覆盖。

5. 建议的修法方向可行：在 `lib.rs:1340-1359` 既有 60s tick 里记住「上次清理的 UTC 日期」，日期变化才调一次（每天最多一次 `read_dir`，成本可忽略），best-effort 只 warn —— 与 `cleanup_old_logs` 本身「失败只 warn 不上抛」的既定约定（`store.rs:665-666`）一致。不必新起线程、不必做成配置项（`store.rs:196-197` 已论证过刻意不做配置项，这条别推翻）。

confirmed.title: 展开行的 trace 首次拉取后永久缓存，而后端折叠会把同一行（id 不变）的 trace 换成最新一次，导致「行是新的、展开内容是旧的」
confirmed.scenario: 打开「调用模型日志」开关。对同一个 Key、同一个请求模型、同为非流式，连发两次成功请求（collapse_key = `ok:{keyId}:{model}:false` 相同）。第一次请求后在日志页展开该行，看到 requestBody/responseBody（第一次的）。第二次请求到达后，后端在同一条内存事件上把 repeat 加到 2、ts/detail 刷成第二次的、**trace 替换成第二次的**，但事件 id 不变。前端该行仍是同一个 LogRow 实例（key=e.id），`trace === undefined` 的守卫已不成立 → 不再重取。结果：行上显示「×2」和第二次的延迟，展开区里却是第一次请求的请求体/响应体/状态码/耗时。排障时据此比对模型映射结果会得出错误结论，且界面没有任何「这是旧快照」的提示。
confirmed.evidence: src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:317 `if (next && entry.hasTrace && trace === undefined && !loadingTrace)` —— 唯一取数条件，取过就再不取；src-tauri/src/store.rs:596-604 折叠分支 `last.repeat = ...; last.ts = entry.ts; last.detail = entry.detail; last.has_trace = entry.has_trace; last.trace = entry.trace;`（id 字段不在被覆盖之列，故前端 key 与缓存都不会失效）；src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:237 `<LogRow key={e.id} .../>`。
confirmed.fix: 把缓存失效判据接上 ts：用 `useState<{ts:number; tr:RequestTrace|null}>` 或在 useEffect 里监听 `open && entry.ts` 变化后重取（`entry.ts` 在折叠时必变）。最省事的写法是把 LogRow 里 trace 的 state 键改成 `${entry.id}:${entry.ts}`，ts 一变就落回 undefined 重新拉一次。

verdict.reason:
Every link in the claimed chain is confirmed in the actual code, and I could not find any invalidating guard.

1) Backend mutates an existing event in place, keeping its id: `src-tauri/src/store.rs:590-608` (`push_event_in_memory`) — on a collapse hit it does `last.repeat = last.repeat.saturating_add(1)` (:596), `last.ts = entry.ts` (:597), `last.detail = entry.detail` (:599), `last.has_trace = entry.has_trace` (:601), `last.trace = entry.trace` (:602), then `return`. `id` is assigned once at construction (`id: uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string()`, store.rs:556) and is never touched by the collapse branch. So the row's identity survives while its trace payload is swapped for the newest one.

2) Collapse key really is per-(key, requested model, streaming) for successful non-streaming forwards: `src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:668` `let collapse = format!("ok:{}:{}:{}", key.id, requested_model, streaming);` fed into `append_event_full` with kind `"route"`. Confirmed by the comment at proxy.rs:614-621 that a successful forward now writes exactly **one** event — so two back-to-back identical successes are genuinely adjacent in the ring and collapse (the `ev.last_mut()` adjacency requirement at store.rs:594 is satisfiable in practice, no intervening event needed).

3) Frontend caches the trace forever and keys the row by id: `src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:317` `if (next && entry.hasTrace && trace === undefined && !loadingTrace)` is the only fetch site (no `useEffect`, no other invalidation anywhere in LogRow, lines 299-399), and `src/pages/LogsPage.tsx:237` `<LogRow key={e.id} entry={e} lang={lang} />`. Because the id is stable, React keeps the same LogRow instance and its `trace`/`open` state across the collapse.

4) The backend lookup would have returned fresh data if asked: `src-tauri/src/store.rs:942-948` `event_trace` finds by id and clones the *current* trace — i.e. the stale display is purely the frontend's永久缓存, not a backend limitation.

5) `reuseUnchanged` does not mask it either: `src/lib/reuseUnchanged.ts:25` compares `JSON.stringify`, so the collapsed entry (ts/detail/repeat changed) yields a **new** object → the header re-renders with the second request's time/detail/`×2`/累计 usage, while the expanded `TraceDetail` (LogsPage.tsx:391-392, 401-441) still renders the first request's requestBody/responseBody/status/latencyMs. The mismatch is visible in the same viewport: header says e.g. `…成功返回 · 900ms ×2`, panel says `HTTP 200 · 320ms` with the first body.

Aggravating variant the finding understates: no collapse/re-expand cycle is needed. If the user simply leaves a row expanded while identical requests keep arriving (the normal way one watches this page during排障), the header updates live and the panel silently freezes on the first snapshot with no "stale" indicator — squarely the project's forbidden form ④「静默用错值而不报错」, in a view whose entire purpose is diagnosing model mapping / request bodies.

Not a deliberate design: store.rs:600-602 documents replacing trace to avoid holding N bodies, and LogsPage.tsx:316 documents "收起再展开不重复请求" — each side is intentional in isolation, but neither accounts for the other, so the interaction is unconsidered rather than by design.
verdict.correction:
Two small factual adjustments to the finding, neither of which changes the verdict:

1) The collapsible successful-forward event's `kind` is `"route"`, not `"request"` (`src-tauri/src/proxy.rs:670-678` passes `"route"`; the old paired `request` event was removed — see the comment at proxy.rs:614-620). The `collapse_key` string in the finding (`ok:{keyId}:{model}:false`) is exactly right (proxy.rs:668). Anyone reproducing this should filter the「路由成功」group, not「调用快照」.

2) The evidence cites store.rs:596-604 as a contiguous block; the exact mutated lines are 596, 597, 599, 601, 602 (comments interleaved). The load-bearing point — `id` is absent from the overwritten set — is correct.

Also worth pairing with it when fixing: `Store::backfill_usage_for_collapsed_event` (store.rs:873-915) likewise mutates an existing row's `detail`/`usage` in place under the same stable id, so any ts-based cache-invalidation key added to LogRow will need `ts` to actually move on that path too — backfill currently updates `detail`/`usage` but **not** `ts`, so a fix keyed only on `${entry.id}:${entry.ts}` will still not refresh after a streaming usage backfill (a much smaller issue, since backfill does not touch `trace`).
